Alexander-Arnold and Palmer recalled to England squad

Trent Alexander-Arnold and Cole Palmer have been recalled to the England squad for the upcoming Nations League fixtures. Both players had previously been dropped from the squad for the World Cup. Their inclusion marks a return to the national team for the upcoming matches.
